reason: The plug belongs at the ascent console, matching the stated final command.
expectation: The plug will arm the console and allow the ascent command.

effect: The plug both armed the console and triggered ascent, completing the chapter in one action.
reaction: The shrinking cave and solar panels made the straightforward final action feel like a satisfying departure.

mostWorthwhile.text: Commanding ascent was worthwhile: it gave the expedition a clear, visual conclusion while keeping the final decision in the astronaut’s hands.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter offered only one obvious action, so there was little opportunity for a meaningful gameplay decision.

surprise.text: The same action both fitted the plug and commanded ascent; I had expected it to allow the command, rather than necessarily perform it too.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: the arming plug and console had a clear purpose, though pressing START happened automatically as part of the combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue to see what the receiving laboratories discover, although this chapter alone offered little puzzle-solving.
